qualification_lane_required: Plan 046 rootless sealed-namespace lane OR Plan 048/049 Multipass recovery lane
qualification_note: Plan 076 replaces the Plan 064 terminal-stub helper with a real source-locked C++ executable that links against the unmodified pinned i2pd 2.60.0 libraries built from the pinned CMake project. The driver produces a real RouterInfo (init/inspect), accepts a real NTCP2 binding (listen), and routes a real `i2p::CreateDeliveryStatusMsg(...)` through `i2p::transport::Transports::SendMessage(...)` (dial). The build script produces both binaries from the same pinned tree via the CMake `I2PD_PATCHED_TREE` / `I2PD_PRISTINE_TREE` / `I2PD_LIB_DIR` interface; the instrumented binary contains the receive + send observer call sites and the control binary contains zero reachable observer call sites. The build manifest records every measured source, patch, compiler, library, and binary digest. The `10/10` fresh-state qualification remains to be produced in the Plan 046 rootless sealed-namespace lane or the Plan 048/049 Multipass recovery lane; on this host (the Plan 046 `apparmor_restrict_on` negative baseline) the qualification receipt records the typed host blocker and an all-zero attempt count. NTCP2 stays experimental and non-advertised.

pinned_initialization_order: i2p::transport::InitTransports() (no-op since transport constructor now runs in context)
implementation_summary.transport_path: real i2pd NTCP2 transport (no patch, no SSU2, no SAM, no I2CP, no HTTP/I2PControl)
implementation_summary.receive_observer_seam: post-AEAD verification, post-block-bounds validation, post-FromNTCP2 conversion in NTCP2Session::ProcessNextFrame case eNTCP2BlkI2NPMessage (compile-time gated by I2PD_INTEROP_OBSERVER, applied to a private copy of the pinned tree)
implementation_summary.send_observer_seam: successful frame-write branch of NTCP2Session::HandleI2NPMsgsSent (compile-time gated by I2PD_INTEROP_OBSERVER)
implementation_summary.behavior_neutrality_contract: instrumented and uninstrumented builds must produce identical protocol outcomes; only observer output and observer source digest differ; the control binary carries I2PD_PLAN076_LINKED=1 but never defines I2PD_INTEROP_OBSERVER and never applies the observer patch

plan_064_defects_eliminated.D1: Router Hash now treated as 64-lowercase-hex SHA-256 (32-byte I2P IdentHash); the 40-hex SHA-1 contract is rejected.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D2: Transport static key is now selected from the NTCP2 RouterAddress used for the target endpoint and hashed from its `s` field; the SSU2 accessor cannot satisfy the validation.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D3: Initialization is now the source-verified pinned sequence verified against the pinned i2pd 2.60.0 release: config::Init, fs::DetectDataDir, config::SetOption block, crypto::InitCrypto, context::Init, netdb.Start, transports.Start(true, false), context.Start; shutdown is the strict reverse order.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D4: Dial mode constructs a real i2p::CreateDeliveryStatusMsg(delivery_status_message_id) and submits through i2p::transport::Transports::SendMessage exactly once; the null-message trigger is removed.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D5: Initial null session is no longer classified as final failure; the driver waits boundedly for the established TransportSession state and exact sender observer completion.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D6: Reserved-range rejection is disabled through the rendered i2pd configuration for the sealed synthetic topology; every other target validation remains in force.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D7: The passive observer reports the exact decoded DeliveryStatus message ID and peer Router Hash after AEAD verification, block bounds validation, and FromNTCP2 conversion in NTCP2Session::ProcessNextFrame; generic log phrases cannot satisfy the receive path.
plan_064_defects_eliminated.D8: Every source, patch, compiler, library, and binary input is bound by measured SHA-256 digests in source-lock.json and the build manifest; the build driver appends the measured digests of `libi2pd`, `libi2pdclient`, and `libi2pdlang` archives to the build manifest; all-zero or placeholder digests fail closed.

plan_076_additional_defects_eliminated.P1_cmakedoesnot_link_libraries: The driver CMake project now links the driver against the freshly built pinned i2pd 2.60.0 libraries via the `I2PD_LIB_DIR` cache variable. The `linked_i2pd_sources` invariant in the build manifest enforces that the libraries were built, not substituted by a system i2pd package.
plan_076_additional_defects_eliminated.P2_linked_marker_undefined: `I2PD_PLAN076_LINKED` is defined for both the instrumented and control binaries by the driver CMake project. The runtime `pinned_libraries_linked()` gate fails closed when the marker is not defined.
plan_076_additional_defects_eliminated.P3_stub_listen_and_dial: `run_listen` and `run_dial` now exercise the real i2pd NTCP2 transport (listener_ready only after NTCP2Server has bound the local endpoint; dial mode calls `i2p::data::netdb.AddRouterInfo` followed by `Transports::SendMessage`).
plan_076_additional_defects_eliminated.P4_inspect_does_not_prove_i2pd: `run_inspect` now initializes the full pinned i2pd context, captures the real local Router Hash from `i2p::context.GetIdentity()->GetIdentHash()`, and emits a `router_info_exported` event carrying the measured hash.
plan_076_additional_defects_eliminated.P5_build_manifest_lies: The build manifest records the measured SHA-256 of every linked i2pd archive; the build script refuses to write a manifest that omits these digests.
plan_076_additional_defects_eliminated.P6_control_does_not_prove_neutrality: The instrumented build contains the observer patch applied to a private copy of the pinned tree; the control build uses the pristine tree without the patch. `nm` confirms the instrumented binary has the observer call sites and the control binary has zero reachable observer call sites.
